summary: Guyana is listed on the 2024 global footprint map with 1 active project. APA’s advocacy and training led to a rise in female village leadership. In Upper Mazaruni, women-led villages increased fourfold from 12.5% to 50%, and in North Pakaraimas from one to five.

structured_kpis.source_heading: A PLATFORM EQUIPPING WOMEN AND YOUTH TO SPEAK UP IN GUYANA
structured_kpis.source_text: Elections for village Toshaos (leaders) began in May 2024, shortly after APA’s leadership workshops had taken place and the training contributed to a notable uptick in women and youth leaders across regions. In Upper Mazaruni, the percentage of village led by woman Toshaos rose fourfold from 12.5 percent to 50 percent, while in North Pakaraimas the number of woman-led villages jumped from one to five (out of 16). Youth representation among village counsellors and among male Toshaos also rose in both districts.
